headline: Scrubbit
title: Scrubbit | Leaf Tail Break Frog | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Scrubbit is a stage three Water Aniimo built for breaking, with a break stat of one hundred seven. It can fly, swim and glide. Frogs Love Baths swings three times for power one hundred twenty and costs forty energy. Bath Shockwave is its ultimate, and it gives a shield. Evolve Lilipole at level sixty two with a Wave Stone to get it. Homeland work is Water level three. Do you own a Scrubbit? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Scrubbit guide: a stage 3 Water break specialist that flies and swims, with Frogs Love Baths and Bath Shockwave. Evolve Lilipole at level 62 with a Wave Stone. Checked on aniimo.gg and GameWith in November 2026.
joke: Scrubbit takes baths so seriously that its tail is a washcloth.
